content_of_post_to_comment: My sister in law and I were talking about kids birthday parties. Let’s just say I have some ~feelings~ about goodie bags. They’re so sweet and cute and well intentioned but, I’m sorry to say, most of the time they are a huge waste of money on unnecessary junk that ends up in the garbage or is just one more thing moms have to clean up/deal with. My sister in law told me for her last son’s bday party, she bought children’s books at the thrift store and each kid got to pick one as they were leaving the party. I think this is absolutely BRILLIANT!! Sustainable, fun, easy, affordable and good for parents AND kids. I just had to pass along in case anyone else wants to use the idea
